name: create_spec
description: Scaffolds a new spec document from a type-specific template and allocates the next SPEC-YYYY-NNN ID. Use when the user asks to start a new spec, draft a new design proposal, or create a revision of an approved spec (with --revise <id>). Do NOT use to edit an existing draft — use Edit on the spec file directly. Do NOT use to copy a spec to a new ID; use --revise so the lineage is preserved.

type.description: Which template to scaffold from. ux-flow for end-to-end user journeys, component for design system components, research for synthesis docs, prd for product specs.

title.description: Human-readable title. Becomes the H1 and the title: frontmatter field.

owner.description: Username of the spec owner (e.g. jane.doe). Must match a known team member.

revise_of.description: Optional. SPEC-YYYY-NNN ID to base this revision on. Required when revising an approved or implemented spec.

path.description: Absolute path to the new spec file
